messages:
julia-customer: Hey team — after the tenant role-graph migration last night I can no longer open the model page or view billing. Console shows a 403 on /orgs/terra/models and billing invoices. Help?
raj-support: Sorry about this, julia. Can you paste the org id and a screenshot of the console error?
julia-customer: org=terra-ops. Screenshot: "Permission denied" modal with request id req_0x9a3f. Also CLI calls to list models return:
```
$ redwood models list --org terra-ops
Error: permission denied (403): access to models:list
request_id=req_0x9a3f
```
raj-support: Thanks. I'm escalating to security & infra. pinging @sarah-sec and @mike-eng.
sarah-sec: I saw the role-graph-v2 merge completed in the midnight deploy. There was a mapping change that migrates legacy "org_admin" -> "org:owner" attributes. Possible attribute mismatch for this tenant. Can you confirm if you recently used a custom role mapping?
julia-customer: No, we didn't touch mappings. We've always used the default mapping. Access was fine before the deploy.
sarah-sec: Ok. @deploy-bot, which rollout included role-graph-v2?
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: role-graph-v2-rollout by lisa-deploy at 2026-03-20T00:12Z. Canary 10% -> 100% completed. Changeset: rbac/service: attribute migration and "drop legacy_role" flag.
sarah-sec: That aligns. @mike-eng can we check the tenancy sync logs and audit entries for terra-ops? Look for failed principal mappings around 00:12Z.
mike-eng: Checking. Found repeated failures in sync worker: `role_graph.sync(): missing attribute 'tenant_scoped_roles' for principal svcacct:terra-billing` starting at 00:13:10Z. I can see the graph migration removed fallback edges for legacy roles.
ops-oncall: Noted. This could have inadvertently orphaned some principals. If confirmed, we should patch to re-add a compatibility edge and run a targeted re-sync for affected orgs.
sarah-sec: Agreed. Raj, please create a support ticket and obtain a signed request from Terra to apply a temporary compat mapping while we roll a proper migration fix. Include request_id.
raj-support: Ticket #SR-24918 created. Asking for signed approval now. Julia, can you confirm and send a signed note from your org admin?
julia-customer: Sent signed approval via secure upload, includes request id req_0x9a3f.
mike-eng: Patch ready: add back attribute fallback mapping `legacy:org_admin -> org:owner` for tenants listed in the remediation set. I'll run `rbacctl sync --org terra-ops --force` after patch. ETA ~8m.
sarah-sec: Also capture audit log entries for the remediation step and mark them for compliance review. Use event tag `remediation:compat_edge`.
mike-eng: Patch applied and sync started. Logs:
```
INFO role_graph: applying compat edge legacy:org_admin->org:owner for org=terra-ops
INFO rbacctl: sync started (forced)
INFO rbacctl: sync completed, 3 principals updated
```
julia-customer: I'm checking now — model list works and billing page loads. Thank you! :tada:
raj-support: Marking SR-24918 as resolved pending postmortem.
sarah-sec: We'll open a vuln triage / postmortem to cover rollout guardrails and add an automated check that ensures fallback edges exist for tenants missing tenant_scoped_roles. Assigning to team-security and eng-runtime.
ops-oncall: Adding a runbook step: before role-graph merges, run `rbacctl dryrun --compat-check` and alert if any tenants fail.
mike-eng: Will add the dry-run gating to the next deploy.
sarah-sec: Great. Julia, can you confirm final ACK for closure?
julia-customer: ACK, everything's working. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
raj-support: Closing thread in 24h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
